Aisha (CSM): quick flag — I pulled a sample and ~120 accounts are marked "onboarded" but have NO 'first_success_call' touch in CRM. some of these just downgraded in the last 30 days. :eyes:
Ethan (CS Ops): yikes. any common owners or templates?
Aisha (CSM): it's a mix, but high concentration on two segments: SMB self-serve and late-conversion pilot cohorts. noticed the contact.touch_type field is empty for many rows.
Samir (Data Eng): can you paste the query you used? we can run a backfill and also create a tag so playbooks can pick them up.
Aisha (CSM): sure — simple repro query:
```sql
SELECT account_id, owner_id, onboarding_status, contact.touch_type, last_touch_ts
FROM crm.accounts a
LEFT JOIN crm.contacts c ON a.account_id = c.account_id
WHERE onboarding_status = 'complete'
  AND (c.touch_type IS NULL OR c.touch_type = '')
  AND a.updated_at > now() - interval '90 days';
```
Aisha (CSM): thought: add a temporary owner-sync job that assigns these to an "onboard-verify" owner queue + enqueue a playbook nudge for accounts without a recorded success call.
Nina (Enablement): I can draft nudge templates. recommend two variants: 1) short checklist (improve adoption) 2) calendar-scheduling prompt (book 15m). we should A/B test copy to measure conversions.
Ethan (CS Ops): technically we can do two things: backfill contact.touch_type with 'system-backfilled' and add a tag 'needs-success-call' OR create a playbook rule that triggers on the query results and pings owner. pref to avoid mass-editing historical data unless we timestamp it.
Samir (Data Eng): agree. propose a small ETL run that marks backfill_source='backfill/2026-03-21' and sets touch_type='system-backfilled'. then create a queued job for playbook runner. sample job payload:
```json
{"action":"enqueue_playbook","playbook_id":"pb_onboard_missing_success_v1","filter":"backfill_source='backfill/2026-03-21' AND tag IS NULL"}
```
ops-bot: deploy:playbook-runner started by ethan — job id c3f9d (ETA ~10m) :robot_face:
Ethan (CS Ops): i'm going to schedule the backfill for 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Samir, can you own the ETL?
Samir (Data Eng): can do. will write a dry-run flag and produce a CSV of affected accounts first.
Nina (Enablement): I'll push two nudge templates to the playbook repo and add tracking params.
Aisha (CSM): thanks — owners: @Samir for ETL, @Ethan for playbook wiring, @Nina for copy. I'll validate a sample of 20 accounts post-run and confirm renewal-risk signals.
Ethan (CS Ops): noted. if the sample shows improvement, we can flip on automated tagging and add a weekly sweep.
Aisha (CSM): timeline: dry-run CSV within 3h, backfill run tonight, playbook dry-run tomorrow morning. any objections?
Samir (Data Eng): none from me.
Nina (Enablement): 👍 I'll have drafts by tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Aisha (CSM): perfect — tagging this thread as follow-up. thanks all. :pray:
ops-bot: reminder created: ticket CS-4321 "onboard verify backfill & playbook" assigned to Samir, Ethan, Nina.
